Class WaitingCmdHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.controller.commandHandlers.CommandHandler
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.controller.commandHandlers.WaitingCmdHandler
public class WaitingCmdHandler extends CommandHandler
Command handler used while the server is in a waiting state.

This handler does not register any specific command logic and ignores all incoming commands. It logs a warning for each received command without taking further action.
